facts.business: Trident Lifeline Limited is an Indian pharmaceutical company engaged in the manufacturing and export of drugs and pharmaceuticals.

auditor.name: M/s. A Bafna & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Managerial remuneration paid to Mr. Hardik Desai (Rs 22.62 Lacs) and Mr. Ashish Anandsingh Bafna (Rs 6.37 Lacs) for FY 2025-26 was in excess of the limit prescribed under Section 197 of the Companies Act, 2013, though within limits approved by members at previous AGM.

key_risks: Revenue recognition risk due to complex estimation of discounts, incentives, rebates and diverse contractual terms across markets
Regulatory compliance risk under Drugs and Cosmetics Act, Drugs and Magic Remedies Act, Drugs Price Control Order
Managerial remuneration exceeding statutory limits under Section 197 of Companies Act, 2013
Foreign exchange fluctuation risk on export earnings and import outgo
Supply chain and geopolitical risks affecting pharmaceutical industry
